scientific_limitations: One exact-three-position non-wrapping permutation burst only; no multiple edits, wraps, or variable lengths.
Uniform center distribution is assumed in moments and Gaussian limit.
Binary pointwise sphere-size decomposition and finite-dependent central limit theorem are previously established tools.
Novelty is not externally certified; coverage by unindexed equivalent formulations remains possible.
title: Two-state sphere spectrum for three-symbol permutation bursts
